Subset notes for the welcome page fonts.

Newsreader and Inter are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see the
two license files here). The license allows modified copies. Neither font
declares a Reserved Font Name.

The woff2 files here are smaller copies of the upstream latin files:
- Characters kept: Basic Latin, Latin-1 Supplement, curly quotes, en and em
  dash, ellipsis, bullet, arrow and minus.
- Newsreader roman and italic: weight axis fixed at 400 (the page only uses
  weight 400), optical size axis kept.
- Inter 400 and 600: static, hinting removed.
- Made with fontTools (instancer and subsetter), woff2 output.
